description: Multi-population (subgroup) trial design with multiplicity control. Use when a confirmatory trial tests the same endpoint in multiple populations — biomarker-positive subgroup + ITT, nested PD-L1 strata, etc. Pick relation='nested' (the canonical case: TPS≥50 ⊂ TPS≥20 ⊂ ITT, all patients enroll into the broadest, total N driven by largest implied-enrolled across strata) or 'disjoint' (strata enrolled separately, total N = sum). Strategies: fixed-sequence (hierarchical), alpha-split, bonferroni. For graphical multiplicity (Maurer-Bretz with alpha recycling between populations), use design_graphical_multiplicity.

alpha_weights.description: For strategy='alpha-split' only. Names match `populations`; sum to 1.

endpoint_args.description: Shared endpoint design parameters (e.g., for survival: model, design_class, control_median, accrual_duration, followup_duration, dropout_rate). The effect parameter (hazard_ratio / p_treatment / delta) is overridden per population.

endpoint_type.description: Endpoint family — selects which design_<type> wrapper handles each population.

ordering.description: For strategy='fixed-sequence' only. Population names in test order.

effect.description: Population-specific effect parameters that override the corresponding fields in endpoint_args. Use {hazard_ratio: 0.65} for survival, {p_treatment: 0.10} for binary, {delta: 0.4} for continuous.

prevalence.description: Fraction of the broadest population in this stratum (required for relation='nested'; ignored for 'disjoint').

populations.description: Named map of populations. Each entry has `effect` (and `prevalence` for nested mode).

reasoning_chain.description: Optional structured citation trail. Each entry: {decision, value, justification, source_type, source_ref?}. design_report() renders this inline; sponsor_confidential entries trigger a redaction prompt.

items.description: One reasoning-chain entry — a single design decision with its provenance. The LLM and user fill the content; the package validates the shape.

decision.description: Short label for the design choice (e.g., 'alpha', 'hazard_ratio').

justification.description: One sentence explaining why this value was chosen.

source_ref.description: Free-text reference (citation, NCT id, internal protocol number). Optional but encouraged for non-default entries.

source_type.description: Provenance tag for a reasoning-chain entry. Drives the design_report redaction prompt (sponsor_confidential entries flagged before sharing).

value.description: The chosen value (numeric, string, or boolean).

relation.description: How populations relate. `nested` (default): subgroups overlap, all patients enroll into the broadest, total N = max of implied-enrolled-N. `disjoint`: separate strata enrolled, total N = sum of per-population N.

strategy.description: Multiplicity-control strategy across populations. `fixed-sequence` is the canonical biomarker pattern (test strongest-effect subgroup first, gate broader strata on rejection).

name: design_multi_population
